title: Keep external technique catalogs separate
summary: Track investigation and adoption of a reusable technique by linking to the owning catalog. Let the adopter and its agent choose a technique, and keep the tracker focused on the project's own decisions and progress.

origin.source: Provenistem standalone planning and repository audit, 2026-11-20.

benefits: Allows one maintained technique catalog to serve multiple projects.
risks: Copying the external records creates a competing source.

evidence.claim: README-HQ records the boundary between technique ownership and project selection.
